title: 非球面光學加工~Aspheric-optics manufacturing
focus: 非球面矢高方程、中頻誤差、確定性拋光、鑽石車削與模造、非球面量測與對心公差~Aspheric sag equation, mid-spatial-frequency error, deterministic polishing, diamond turning and molding, asphere metrology and centring tolerances
summary: 以一片半徑 50 mm、口徑 50 mm 的拋物面為貫穿案例：先用矢高方程算出它與球面的偏離量與斜率，說明為何無法用標準球面工法與干涉儀直接處理，再拆解 CNC 研磨、磁流變等確定性次口徑拋光的去除率與收斂、單點鑽石車削的理論粗糙度與精密玻璃模造的收縮補償，接著以輪廓儀、CGH 干涉與拼接量測建立誤差預算，最後以對心公差、熱穩定性與 ISO 10110 圖面完成驗收交接。~Using a paraboloid of 50 mm radius and 50 mm aperture as the running case, the course first computes its departure from a sphere and its slope with the sag equation to show why standard spherical methods and interferometers cannot handle it directly, then dissects CNC grinding, the removal rate and convergence of deterministic subaperture polishing such as MRF, the theoretical roughness of single-point diamond turning and the shrinkage compensation of precision glass molding, builds an error budget from profilometry, CGH interferometry and stitching, and finishes with centring tolerances, thermal stability and ISO 10110 drawing-based acceptance.

units.anchor: 非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數~Aspheric sag equation and conic constant
units.title: 為何需要非球面：矢高、偏離量與斜率~Why aspheres: sag, departure and slope
units.mechanism: 球面只有一個自由度（曲率），無法同時滿足聚焦與消球差，所以 f 數小的鏡片必須多片組合；非球面以矢高方程 z(r) = c·r²/[1 + √(1 − (1+k)c²r²)] + Σ A₂ᵢ·r²ⁱ 加入圓錐常數 k 與高次項，一面就能消除球差。代價是表面不再有旋轉對稱球面那種「任何方向都一樣」的性質：曲率隨半徑變化，傳統靠工具與工件互磨自然成形的球面工法失效，量測也不能直接用球面參考波前。偏離量與斜率的大小決定了加工與量測方法。~A sphere has a single degree of freedom, its curvature, and cannot focus and cancel spherical aberration at once, so fast lenses need many elements; an asphere adds a conic constant k and higher-order terms through the sag equation z(r) = c·r²/[1 + √(1 − (1+k)c²r²)] + Σ A₂ᵢ·r²ⁱ and removes spherical aberration with one surface. The price is losing the property of a sphere that every direction is alike: curvature varies with radius, so traditional spherical lapping in which tool and part grind each other into shape no longer works, and testing cannot simply use a spherical reference wavefront. The magnitude of departure and slope decides which fabrication and metrology methods apply.
units.model: R = 50 mm、k = −1（拋物面）、口徑 50 mm：邊緣 r = 25 mm 的拋物面矢高 z = r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm，同頂點曲率球面的矢高 z = R − √(R² − r²) = 50 − 43.30 = 6.70 mm，偏離量 0.45 mm；對最佳擬合球面的偏離約為四分之一，即 110 µm，邊緣的偏離斜率約 2×(r⁴/8R³)/r = 2×0.39/25 ≈ 31 mrad。~With R = 50 mm, k = −1 (a paraboloid) and a 50 mm aperture, the paraboloid sag at the edge r = 25 mm is z = r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm, the sphere of the same vertex curvature has z = R − √(R² − r²) = 50 − 43.30 = 6.70 mm, a departure of 0.45 mm; the departure from the best-fit sphere is about a quarter of that, 110 µm, and the departure slope at the edge is about 2×(r⁴/8R³)/r = 2×0.39/25 ≈ 31 mrad.
units.verify: 用設計軟體或試算表對同一方程算出每 1 mm 半徑的矢高、對最佳擬合球面的偏離與斜率，畫成曲線並標出最大斜率位置；再以此表決定干涉儀是否需要補償器、輪廓儀探針是否會因斜率而失準。~Tabulate the sag, best-fit-sphere departure and slope every 1 mm of radius from the same equation in design software or a spreadsheet, plot them and mark the position of maximum slope; use that table to decide whether the interferometer needs a null compensator and whether a profilometer stylus would misread because of the slope.
units.failure: 若把非球面係數的符號約定或單位搞錯（例如把 A₄ 以 mm⁻³ 當成 mm⁻⁴），加工出的表面在邊緣偏離設計數十微米，量測時整片表面看似合格的球面卻完全不是設計的非球面。~A sign-convention or unit error in the aspheric coefficients (for example treating A₄ in mm⁻³ as mm⁻⁴) produces a surface tens of micrometres off design at the edge, and metrology shows a seemingly fine sphere that is simply not the asphere designed.
units.misconception: 非球面只是比較精密的球面，用同樣工法就能做。~An asphere is just a more precise sphere and can be made the same way.

units.anchor: 表面誤差功率譜密度~Surface-error power spectral density
units.title: 面形、中頻漣波與粗糙度的頻段劃分~Figure, mid-spatial-frequency ripple and roughness bands
units.mechanism: 非球面加工的誤差按空間頻率分成三段：低頻面形誤差對應像差，可由後續修形去除；中頻漣波（週期約 0.1 到 10 mm）是次口徑工具沿軌跡留下的週期結構，會把光散射到像點附近形成小角度的眩光與對比損失；高頻粗糙度造成大角度散射。球面全口徑拋光天然不產生中頻，而非球面依賴小工具，所以中頻誤差成為非球面特有的品質問題，必須用功率譜密度（PSD）而不是單一的 PV 或 RMS 數字來規範。~Errors in aspheric fabrication fall into three spatial-frequency bands: low-frequency figure error maps to aberration and can be corrected by subsequent figuring; mid-spatial-frequency ripple (periods of roughly 0.1 to 10 mm) is the periodic structure left along the tool path by subaperture tools and scatters light close to the image point as small-angle flare with contrast loss; high-frequency roughness scatters at large angles. Full-aperture spherical polishing produces no mid-frequency content naturally, whereas aspheres depend on small tools, so mid-spatial-frequency error is a quality problem specific to aspheres that must be specified with a power spectral density rather than a single PV or RMS number.
units.model: 週期 Λ = 2 mm 的漣波把 633 nm 的光散射到 θ ≈ λ/Λ = 0.32 mrad。反射面 RMS 漣波 σ = 5 nm 的散射比例 TIS ≈ (4πσ/λ)² = (4π×5/633)² ≈ 0.0099，約 1%；同樣漣波在 n = 1.52 的透射面只有 (2π(n − 1)σ/λ)² = (2π×0.52×5/633)² ≈ 0.00067，約 0.07%，相差 15 倍。~Ripple with period Λ = 2 mm scatters 633 nm light to θ ≈ λ/Λ = 0.32 mrad. For a reflective surface with RMS ripple σ = 5 nm the scattered fraction is TIS ≈ (4πσ/λ)² = (4π×5/633)² ≈ 0.0099, about 1%; the same ripple on a transmitting surface with n = 1.52 gives only (2π(n − 1)σ/λ)² = (2π×0.52×5/633)² ≈ 0.00067, about 0.07%, a factor of 15 less.
units.verify: 以干涉儀量面形、以白光干涉顯微鏡在數個視場尺寸量中高頻，把各段資料合成 PSD 曲線並與規格的 PSD 上限比較；對關鍵的中頻段用帶通濾波後的 RMS 值核對，並用 TIS 公式估算散射損失與實測的散射量比對。~Measure figure with an interferometer and mid-to-high frequencies with a white-light interference microscope at several field sizes, merge the data into a PSD curve and compare with the specified PSD ceiling; check the critical mid-frequency band with band-pass-filtered RMS values and compare the TIS-estimated scatter loss with measured scatter.
units.failure: 規格只寫 PV 0.1 µm 而不限制 PSD 時，供應商用小工具把面形修到合格，卻留下 10 nm 的中頻漣波，裝進雷射系統後出現環狀眩光與光束品質下降，追溯時每張報告都顯示合格。~When the drawing specifies only PV 0.1 µm without a PSD limit, a supplier figures the surface into tolerance with a small tool yet leaves 10 nm of mid-frequency ripple, the laser system then shows ring-shaped flare and beam-quality loss, and every report in the trail still reads as compliant.
units.misconception: PV 與 RMS 合格就代表表面品質合格。~Passing PV and RMS means the surface quality is acceptable.

units.anchor: CNC 研磨與磁流變拋光頭~CNC grinding and MRF polishing head
units.title: 確定性次口徑拋光：去除函數、停留時間與收斂~Deterministic subaperture polishing: removal function, dwell time and convergence
units.mechanism: 非球面先以 CNC 金剛石砂輪依矢高方程研磨成形，留下數微米的面形誤差與次表面損傷層，再進入確定性拋光：磁流變拋光（MRF）、氣囊拋光或小工具電腦控制拋光都以一個已校正的工具去除函數（TIF）在表面上移動，停留時間圖由誤差圖與 TIF 的反卷積求得，去除量與停留時間成正比。每次疊代把誤差降低一個收斂比，通常需要兩到三次量測與拋光循環；MRF 的剪切去除機制幾乎不施壓，因此不會引入新的次表面損傷。~An asphere is first ground to the sag equation with a CNC diamond wheel, leaving several micrometres of figure error and a subsurface damage layer, then enters deterministic polishing: magnetorheological finishing (MRF), bonnet polishing or computer-controlled small-tool polishing all move a calibrated tool influence function (TIF) over the surface, the dwell-time map is obtained by deconvolving the error map with the TIF, and removal is proportional to dwell time. Each iteration reduces the error by a convergence ratio, so two or three measure-and-polish cycles are usual; the shear-based removal of MRF applies almost no pressure and introduces no new subsurface damage.
units.model: 研磨後殘留 3 µm PV 面形誤差，平均需去除 1.5 µm；口徑 50 mm 的面積 π×25² ≈ 1963 mm²，去除體積 ≈ 1963×1.5×10⁻³ ≈ 2.9 mm³；以 MRF 體積去除率 0.1 mm³/min 計約 29 min。若每次收斂比為 7，兩次循環後殘差約 3/49 ≈ 0.06 µm PV，達到 λ/10 等級。~After grinding the residual figure error is 3 µm PV, requiring an average removal of 1.5 µm; the 50 mm aperture has area π×25² ≈ 1963 mm², so the removal volume is ≈ 1963×1.5×10⁻³ ≈ 2.9 mm³, about 29 min at an MRF volumetric removal rate of 0.1 mm³/min. With a convergence ratio of 7 per run, two cycles leave about 3/49 ≈ 0.06 µm PV, i.e. λ/10 class.
units.verify: 先在同材質試片上以固定停留時間做一個去除斑並量測其深度與形狀，得到實際 TIF 與去除率；拋光後再量面形，計算實際收斂比並與預測比較，若低於 3 表示 TIF 漂移、定位誤差或量測與機台座標不一致。~First polish a single spot on a coupon of the same material for a fixed dwell time and measure its depth and shape to obtain the actual TIF and removal rate; after polishing, re-measure figure, compute the achieved convergence ratio and compare with prediction, since a ratio below 3 indicates TIF drift, positioning error or a mismatch between metrology and machine coordinates.
units.failure: 研磨留下的次表面裂紋若未被足夠的拋光去除量清除，表面在鍍膜或熱循環後出現微裂與散射，甚至在高功率雷射下損傷，而面形量測在交貨時完全正常。~If subsurface cracks from grinding are not removed by sufficient polishing depth, the surface develops micro-cracks and scatter after coating or thermal cycling and may even damage under high laser power, while figure metrology at delivery looked perfectly normal.
units.misconception: 拋光越久表面一定越好。~Longer polishing always yields a better surface.

units.anchor: 鑽石車刀與玻璃模具~Diamond tool and glass mold
units.title: 單點鑽石車削與精密玻璃模造~Single-point diamond turning and precision glass molding
units.mechanism: 金屬、紅外晶體與塑膠的非球面常以單點鑽石車削直接成形：工件在空氣主軸上旋轉，鑽石刀尖沿非球面軌跡以奈米級解析度進給，表面粗糙度由進給量與刀尖半徑決定，形狀精度由機台的定位精度與熱穩定性決定。大量生產的玻璃非球面則用精密玻璃模造：玻璃預形體加熱到轉變溫度以上，在碳化鎢或碳化矽模具之間壓製成形後緩慢冷卻；模具本身是以研磨拋光做出的非球面，並且必須預先補償玻璃冷卻收縮與折射率因冷卻速率下降的效應。~Aspheres in metals, infrared crystals and plastics are often shaped directly by single-point diamond turning: the part rotates on an air-bearing spindle while a diamond tool follows the aspheric path with nanometre feed resolution; roughness is set by feed and tool-nose radius, and form accuracy by the machine's positioning accuracy and thermal stability. High-volume glass aspheres use precision glass molding instead: a glass preform is heated above its transition temperature, pressed between tungsten-carbide or silicon-carbide molds and cooled slowly; the molds are themselves ground and polished aspheres and must pre-compensate the shrinkage of the glass on cooling and the refractive-index drop caused by the cooling rate.
units.model: 鑽石車削的理論粗糙度 h = f²/(8R_t)：進給 f = 5 µm/rev、刀尖半徑 R_t = 0.5 mm 時 h = 25/(8×500) µm ≈ 6 nm PV，對應約 2 nm Ra。玻璃模造：玻璃 α = 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹，從 470 °C 冷卻到 20 °C 的線性收縮 8×10⁻⁶×450 = 0.36%，口徑 10 mm 的鏡片縮小 36 µm，模具必須按此放大。~The theoretical roughness of diamond turning is h = f²/(8R_t): with feed f = 5 µm/rev and tool-nose radius R_t = 0.5 mm, h = 25/(8×500) µm ≈ 6 nm PV, roughly 2 nm Ra. For glass molding, a glass with α = 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ cooled from 470 °C to 20 °C shrinks linearly by 8×10⁻⁶×450 = 0.36%, so a 10 mm lens contracts by 36 µm and the mold must be scaled up accordingly.
units.verify: 車削件以白光干涉顯微鏡量粗糙度並與 f²/(8R_t) 比較，差異大表示刀尖磨損或主軸振動；模造件則量第一批成品的面形與設計差，把誤差反向補償到模具再做第二批，確認收縮與折射率變化的補償收斂。~Measure the roughness of turned parts with a white-light interference microscope and compare with f²/(8R_t), where a large discrepancy indicates tool wear or spindle vibration; for molded parts, measure the figure error of the first batch against design, feed the inverse error back into the mold and run a second batch to confirm that the shrinkage and index-change compensation converges.
units.failure: 鑽石刀尖在車削矽或鍺時磨損，粗糙度從 2 nm 升到 10 nm 以上，紅外鏡片透過率因散射下降；模造時若脫模溫度過高或模具鍍層劣化，玻璃黏模造成表面缺陷與面形偏差，整批報廢。~Diamond tool wear while turning silicon or germanium raises roughness from 2 nm to over 10 nm and the infrared lens loses transmission to scatter; in molding, releasing at too high a temperature or a degraded mold coating makes the glass stick, producing surface defects and figure deviation that scrap the batch.
units.misconception: 模造鏡片與拋光鏡片的折射率完全相同。~Molded lenses have exactly the same refractive index as polished ones.

units.anchor: 輪廓儀探針與 CGH 零位鏡~Profilometer stylus and CGH null
units.title: 非球面量測：輪廓儀、CGH 干涉與拼接~Asphere metrology: profilometry, CGH interferometry and stitching
units.mechanism: 非球面與球面參考波前干涉時，條紋密度由偏離斜率決定，超過相機解析度就無法量測，因此需要讓參考波前變成非球面的零位元件：電腦全像片（CGH）以繞射產生設計波前，或用折射式零位鏡；另一條路是不做零位而用次口徑拼接或傾斜波干涉儀。接觸式與光學輪廓儀逐點掃描剖面，不受斜率的條紋限制但速度慢、取樣稀，且探針半徑與斜率會產生系統性的量測誤差。工程上通常以輪廓儀做前段加工的量測，以 CGH 干涉做最終驗收。~When an asphere interferes with a spherical reference wavefront the fringe density is set by the departure slope, and beyond the camera's resolution nothing can be measured, so a null element must turn the reference into the aspheric wavefront: a computer-generated hologram (CGH) produces the design wavefront by diffraction, or a refractive null lens does; the alternative is to avoid a null and use subaperture stitching or a tilted-wave interferometer. Contact and optical profilometers scan profiles point by point, free of the fringe limit but slow and sparse, with systematic errors from stylus radius and slope. In practice profilometry serves the early fabrication stages and CGH interferometry the final acceptance.
units.model: 1000 像素相機涵蓋 50 mm 口徑時每像素 50 µm，Nyquist 要求條紋間距至少 100 µm，對應表面斜率上限 λ/(2×100 µm) = 0.633/200 ≈ 3.2 mrad（雙程）；拋物面邊緣 31 mrad 的偏離斜率超出 10 倍，條紋間距只有 0.633/(2×0.031) ≈ 10 µm，必須用 CGH 零位或拼接。~A 1000-pixel camera over a 50 mm aperture gives 50 µm per pixel, Nyquist requires fringe spacing of at least 100 µm, corresponding to a surface-slope limit of λ/(2×100 µm) = 0.633/200 ≈ 3.2 mrad in double pass; the paraboloid's 31 mrad edge slope exceeds this tenfold, with fringes only 0.633/(2×0.031) ≈ 10 µm apart, so a CGH null or stitching is mandatory.
units.verify: 以 CGH 干涉量得的面形圖與輪廓儀的兩條正交剖面比較，扣除傾斜與離焦後殘差應在兩種方法的不確定度合成值內；另外用 CGH 的對準區確認 CGH 與干涉儀的相對位置，並量測一片已知球面以確認干涉儀本身的參考誤差。~Compare the figure map from CGH interferometry with two orthogonal profilometer traces; after removing tilt and defocus the residual should lie within the combined uncertainty of the two methods; also use the CGH alignment zone to confirm its position relative to the interferometer, and measure a known sphere to establish the interferometer's own reference error.
units.failure: CGH 若相對干涉儀偏心 20 µm，量到的面形會多出一個假的彗差項，修形機台照著去除後反而把真正合格的表面做壞，下一次量測又顯示相反方向的彗差。~A CGH decentred by 20 µm relative to the interferometer adds a spurious coma term to the measured figure; the figuring machine removes it faithfully and spoils a surface that was actually within tolerance, and the next measurement shows coma of the opposite sign.
units.misconception: 干涉儀的條紋越密，量測資訊越豐富。~Denser interferometer fringes carry more measurement information.

units.anchor: 非球面軸與機械軸偏心~Aspheric axis versus mechanical axis
units.title: 非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算~Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget
units.mechanism: 球面沒有軸，任何通過球心的直線都是對稱軸；非球面卻有唯一的對稱軸，它與鏡片的機械軸（外圓）或另一面的光軸若不重合，整個偏離量分佈就相對光瞳平移，產生與偏心量乘以局部斜率成正比的彗差型表面誤差。因此非球面的誤差預算除了面形、中頻與粗糙度，還要包含非球面軸的偏心與傾斜、中心厚度與頂點位置，這些量在球面鏡片上幾乎不需要關心。~A sphere has no axis, since any line through its centre is an axis of symmetry; an asphere has a unique symmetry axis, and if it does not coincide with the mechanical axis of the lens edge or the optical axis of the other surface, the whole departure map shifts relative to the pupil, producing a coma-like surface error proportional to decentration times local slope. The error budget of an asphere therefore includes, beyond figure, mid-frequency and roughness, the decentration and tilt of the aspheric axis, the centre thickness and the vertex position, quantities that hardly matter for spherical elements.
units.model: 偏離斜率 31 mrad 的邊緣處，非球面軸偏心 δ = 10 µm 造成表面誤差 ≈ 0.031×10 µm = 0.31 µm；折射面乘上 (n − 1) = 0.52 後為 0.16 µm 波前，相當於 633 nm 的 0.25 波，遠超 λ/14。要把此項壓到 0.02 波，偏心必須小於 0.8 µm。~At the edge where the departure slope is 31 mrad, a decentration of the aspheric axis δ = 10 µm produces a surface error ≈ 0.031×10 µm = 0.31 µm; multiplied by (n − 1) = 0.52 for a refracting surface this is 0.16 µm of wavefront, 0.25 waves at 633 nm, far beyond λ/14. To keep this term at 0.02 waves the decentration must be below 0.8 µm.
units.verify: 用對心儀分別量兩面的頂點反射像與非球面的軸（以多環帶反射或干涉法找對稱軸），計算非球面軸對機械軸的偏心與傾斜；再把量到的面形圖以 6 個剛體自由度擬合，確認面形殘差中的彗差項與偏心量乘斜率的預測一致。~Use a centring instrument to locate the vertex reflections of both surfaces and the axis of the asphere (finding the symmetry axis from multiple annular reflections or interferometry), compute the decentration and tilt of the aspheric axis relative to the mechanical axis; then fit the measured figure map with 6 rigid-body degrees of freedom and confirm that the coma term in the residual matches decentration times slope.
units.failure: 修邊時若以球面那一側的光軸為基準，非球面軸對外圓偏心 15 µm，鏡片裝入鏡筒後彗差固定存在且無法用旋轉消除，整個鏡頭的 MTF 在全視場都下降。~If edging is referenced to the optical axis of the spherical side, the aspheric axis ends up 15 µm off the edge; once mounted, the coma is permanent and cannot be removed by rotation, and the whole lens loses MTF across the field.
units.misconception: 非球面鏡片只要面形合格，對心和球面鏡一樣容易。~An asphere with good figure is as easy to centre as a spherical lens.

units.anchor: 鏡筒介面與熱膨脹~Barrel interface and thermal expansion
units.title: 安裝、材料熱特性與環境穩定性~Mounting, material thermal behaviour and environmental stability
units.mechanism: 非球面鏡片裝入鏡筒時以邊緣與斜面定位，夾持力與黏著劑收縮都可能把面形壓變形；材料的選擇決定熱穩定性：玻璃的 dn/dT 與熱膨脹都很小，塑膠的 dn/dT 為負且數量級大一百倍，模造玻璃居中。整合時要用熱光系數估算焦距隨溫度的漂移，並決定是否需要被動無熱化（混合不同材料）或主動對焦。鏡筒材料的膨脹也會改變鏡片間距，與鏡片本身的效應同時計入。~An asphere is located in its barrel by its edge and a bevel, and clamping force or adhesive shrinkage can distort the figure; the material choice sets thermal stability, since glass has small dn/dT and expansion, plastic has a negative dn/dT a hundred times larger, and molded glass lies between. Integration uses the thermo-optic coefficients to estimate focal-length drift with temperature and to decide whether passive athermalisation by mixing materials or active focusing is needed. Barrel-material expansion also changes element spacing and must be counted together with the elements themselves.
units.model: 焦距溫度漂移 Δf/f ≈ α − (dn/dT)/(n − 1)。塑膠非球面 dn/dT = −1×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹、α = 7×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹、n = 1.49：Δf/f = 7×10⁻⁵ + 1×10⁻⁴/0.49 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹，f = 10 mm 升溫 20 K 漂移 54 µm；玻璃 dn/dT = 2×10⁻⁶、α = 7×10⁻⁶、n = 1.52：Δf/f ≈ 3.2×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹，同條件僅 0.6 µm，相差約 90 倍。~Focal drift with temperature is Δf/f ≈ α − (dn/dT)/(n − 1). A plastic asphere with dn/dT = −1×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹, α = 7×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹ and n = 1.49 gives Δf/f = 7×10⁻⁵ + 1×10⁻⁴/0.49 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹, so f = 10 mm drifts 54 µm for a 20 K rise; a glass with dn/dT = 2×10⁻⁶, α = 7×10⁻⁶ and n = 1.52 gives Δf/f ≈ 3.2×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹, only 0.6 µm under the same conditions, about 90 times less.
units.verify: 把組裝好的鏡組放入溫控箱，在 0 到 40 °C 之間每 10 K 量一次最佳焦面位置與波前，擬合焦距對溫度的斜率並與熱光模型比較；同時在鏡片裝入前後各量一次面形，確認夾持與黏著引起的面形變化小於預算。~Place the assembled lens in a thermal chamber and measure best-focus position and wavefront every 10 K from 0 to 40 °C, fit the slope of focal length against temperature and compare with the thermo-optic model; also measure figure before and after mounting to confirm that clamping and adhesive distortion stay within budget.
units.failure: 塑膠非球面在車用鏡頭中經歷 −40 到 85 °C 的溫差，焦點漂移數百微米，若鏡組未無熱化，影像在冬夏兩季都失焦，而室溫下的驗收測試完全合格。~A plastic asphere in an automotive lens sees −40 to 85 °C, drifting focus by hundreds of micrometres; without athermalisation the image is out of focus in both winter and summer, although the room-temperature acceptance test passed completely.
units.misconception: 鏡片面形合格，安裝後面形不會改變。~A lens with good figure keeps that figure after mounting.

units.anchor: ISO 10110 圖面與量測不確定度~ISO 10110 drawing and measurement uncertainty
units.title: 非球面圖面規格、量測比與驗收交接~Asphere drawing specification, test-uncertainty ratio and handoff
units.mechanism: 非球面的圖面依 ISO 10110 系列標示：非球面方程與係數、面形公差（PV、RMS 與斜率）、中頻 PSD 或帶限 RMS、粗糙度、對心公差與中心厚度，每一項都要指明量測方法與去除的擬合項（例如扣除傾斜與離焦）。驗收報告要附上量測不確定度，依慣例量測不確定度應小於公差的四分之一（量測比 4:1）；達不到時需要改進量測或用兩種獨立方法交叉驗證。交接文件還要包含實測的矢高表或面形圖檔，供光學設計做「實測重最佳化」。~Asphere drawings follow the ISO 10110 series: the aspheric equation and coefficients, figure tolerance (PV, RMS and slope), mid-frequency PSD or band-limited RMS, roughness, centring tolerance and centre thickness, each with its measurement method and the fitted terms removed (for example tilt and defocus). The acceptance report must state measurement uncertainty, which by convention should be below a quarter of the tolerance (a 4:1 test-uncertainty ratio); when that cannot be reached, the metrology must improve or two independent methods must cross-validate. The handoff package also includes the measured sag table or figure map so the optical designer can re-optimise with as-built data.
units.model: 面形公差 25 nm RMS 時，4:1 量測比要求不確定度 ≤ 6 nm。CGH 測試的不確定度預算：CGH 基板面形 10 nm、圖樣定位誤差 0.1 µm 對 10 µm 線距產生 λ/100 ≈ 6 nm、對準 5 nm、干涉儀參考 5 nm，RSS = √(100+36+25+25) ≈ 13.6 nm，量測比僅 1.8:1，必須改用更好的基板或扣除已校正的基板誤差。~For a 25 nm RMS figure tolerance, a 4:1 ratio requires uncertainty ≤ 6 nm. A CGH test uncertainty budget: CGH substrate figure 10 nm, pattern placement error of 0.1 µm on 10 µm line spacing giving λ/100 ≈ 6 nm, alignment 5 nm and interferometer reference 5 nm give RSS = √(100+36+25+25) ≈ 13.6 nm, a ratio of only 1.8:1, so a better substrate or subtraction of the calibrated substrate error is needed.
units.verify: 逐項建立量測不確定度預算並以已校正的參考件（球面或已知非球面）驗證；把 CGH 干涉與輪廓儀的結果相減，差異的 RMS 應接近兩者不確定度的合成值；核對圖面每一項規格在報告中都有對應的量測值、方法與擬合項說明。~Build the uncertainty budget term by term and validate it with calibrated reference parts (a sphere or a known asphere); subtract the CGH-interferometric and profilometer results, where the RMS of the difference should approach the combined uncertainty; check that every specification on the drawing has a corresponding measured value, method and fitted-term statement in the report.
units.failure: 報告只寫「面形 20 nm RMS 合格」而未註明扣除了哪些項與量測不確定度，客戶用不同的擬合方式重算得到 40 nm，雙方對同一片鏡片各執一詞，交期因重測與爭議延後數週。~A report stating only that figure is 20 nm RMS and compliant, without naming the removed terms or the uncertainty, lets the customer recompute 40 nm with a different fit, both sides defend their number for the same lens, and delivery slips by weeks of retesting and dispute.
units.misconception: 量測儀器的解析度就是量測不確定度。~An instrument's resolution equals its measurement uncertainty.

example: 非球面加工練習：拋物面 R = 50 mm、k = −1、口徑 50 mm。邊緣矢高：拋物面 r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm，同頂點球面 50 − √(50² − 25²) = 6.70 mm，偏離量 0.45 mm；對最佳擬合球面約 110 µm，邊緣斜率約 31 mrad。干涉儀：1000 像素相機每像素 50 µm，可量斜率上限約 3.2 mrad，條紋間距在邊緣只有 0.633/(2×0.031) ≈ 10 µm，因此採用 CGH 零位測試。加工：研磨後 3 µm PV，去除體積 1963 mm²×1.5 µm ≈ 2.9 mm³，MRF 以 0.1 mm³/min 需 29 min；收斂比 7，兩次循環後 0.06 µm PV。對心：10 µm 偏心乘 31 mrad 得 0.31 µm 表面誤差，乘 (n − 1) = 0.52 為 0.16 µm 波前 ≈ 0.25 波，因此對心公差訂為 1 µm。驗收：面形 25 nm RMS、CGH 量測不確定度 13.6 nm，量測比 1.8:1 不足，改用面形 5 nm 的 CGH 基板後 RSS ≈ √(25+36+25+25) ≈ 10.5 nm，接近 2.4:1，並以輪廓儀交叉驗證。數值皆為教學假設。~Asphere manufacturing exercise: paraboloid R = 50 mm, k = −1, 50 mm aperture. Edge sag: paraboloid r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm, same-vertex sphere 50 − √(50² − 25²) = 6.70 mm, departure 0.45 mm; about 110 µm from the best-fit sphere with an edge slope of about 31 mrad. Interferometry: a 1000-pixel camera at 50 µm per pixel can resolve slopes up to about 3.2 mrad, while fringes at the edge are only 0.633/(2×0.031) ≈ 10 µm apart, so a CGH null test is chosen. Fabrication: 3 µm PV after grinding, removal volume 1963 mm²×1.5 µm ≈ 2.9 mm³, 29 min of MRF at 0.1 mm³/min; with a convergence ratio of 7, two cycles reach 0.06 µm PV. Centring: 10 µm of decentration times 31 mrad gives 0.31 µm of surface error, times (n − 1) = 0.52 gives 0.16 µm of wavefront ≈ 0.25 waves, so the centring tolerance is set at 1 µm. Acceptance: figure 25 nm RMS with a CGH uncertainty of 13.6 nm is a 1.8:1 ratio, insufficient; a CGH substrate of 5 nm figure gives RSS ≈ √(25+36+25+25) ≈ 10.5 nm, close to 2.4:1, and a profilometer cross-check is added. All values are teaching assumptions.
history: 笛卡兒在 1637 年已描述能消球差的非球面，但長期無法加工；1930 年施密特以真空變形法做出施密特校正板，1960 年代美國實驗室與機床廠發展出單點鑽石車削，1970 年代電腦全像片開始用於非球面零位測試，1980 年代起精密玻璃模造讓小口徑玻璃非球面進入量產，1990 年代羅徹斯特發展的磁流變拋光把確定性修形帶入工業。今天從智慧型手機的塑膠非球面到微影鏡頭的大型非球面都依賴這些方法。本課只重建公開的工程原理。~Descartes described spherical-aberration-free aspheric surfaces as early as 1637, but they remained unmanufacturable for centuries; Schmidt made his corrector plate by vacuum deformation in 1930, single-point diamond turning emerged from US laboratories and machine builders in the 1960s, computer-generated holograms entered aspheric null testing in the 1970s, precision glass molding brought small glass aspheres into volume production from the 1980s, and magnetorheological finishing developed in Rochester in the 1990s brought deterministic figuring to industry. Today everything from plastic smartphone aspheres to large lithography aspheres relies on these methods. This course reconstructs only public engineering principles.
